key.name: island-position
key.description: Horizontal anchor position of the Dynamic Island on the target monitor.

key.name: use-custom-position
key.description: When enabled, positions the Dynamic Island at the user-dragged coordinates instead of the preset anchor.

key.name: custom-x
key.description: Monitor-relative X coordinate saved after dragging the Dynamic Island.

key.name: custom-y
key.description: Monitor-relative Y coordinate saved after dragging the Dynamic Island.

key.name: monitor-mode
key.description: Controls whether the island renders on the primary monitor, focused monitor, or all monitors.

key.name: top-offset
key.description: Distance from the top edge of the monitor workarea so the island sits cleanly below the GNOME top bar.

key.name: compact-width
key.description: Width of the Dynamic Island in compact media state (pixels).

key.name: compact-height
key.description: Height of the Dynamic Island in compact state (pixels).

key.name: expanded-width
key.description: Width of the Dynamic Island in expanded state (pixels).

key.name: expanded-height
key.description: Target height of the Dynamic Island in expanded state (pixels).

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Border radius for expanded and focus states; compact state remains pill-shaped.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Translucent dark glass surface opacity (0.04 = 96% max transparency over the wallpaper).

key.name: background-color
key.description: Base tint color used for the translucent glass surface in #RRGGBB format.

key.name: blur-intensity
key.description: Compositor Shell.BlurEffect subtle background blur intensity (0 disables blur, 10 applies gentle frost blur).

key.name: border-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the subtle outer glass edge highlight.

key.name: shadow-intensity
key.description: Strength of the soft floating drop shadow beneath the Dynamic Island.

key.name: animation-speed
key.description: Controls duration and spring curve pacing for state transitions.

key.name: compact-appearance
key.description: Selects what is emphasized inside the compact pill.

key.name: expanded-appearance
key.description: Controls visual density of the expanded glass control panel.

key.name: enable-media
key.description: Show Spotify and browser MPRIS media playback controls.

key.name: enable-audio
key.description: Show master volume, microphone mute, and PipeWire output/input device selectors.

key.name: enable-brightness
key.description: Show screen backlight brightness controls when supported hardware is present.

key.name: enable-quick-settings
key.description: Show Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Battery, Night Light, and Do Not Disturb tiles.

key.name: show-album-artwork
key.description: Display cover art thumbnails in compact, expanded, and focus media views.

key.name: auto-expand-on-music
key.description: Show a temporary glass music notification when playback starts or track changes.

key.name: auto-expand-on-volume
key.description: Briefly expand the pill to show volume changes when collapsed.

key.name: auto-expand-on-brightness
key.description: Briefly expand the pill to show brightness changes when collapsed.

key.name: auto-collapse-delay
key.description: Duration before temporary smart HUD expansions return to compact mode.
